paths.title: Academy Master
paths.description: Master the fundamentals of arcane magic until even your simplest spells set up stronger follow-up attacks and strike with greater force. Your schooling sharpens your Arcana knowledge, while an action point gives you a chance to correct a missed attack. You can pour extra power into familiar spells, reclaim an encounter attack that misses every target, and eventually turn a practiced encounter spell into a more punishing assault with longer-lasting effects.

paths.title: Arcane Armorer
paths.description: Turn your allies' armor into a spellcaster's weapon, laying wards that blunt incoming energy and make shielded friends harder to exploit. Spending an action point lets you hand a nearby ally resistance to a chosen energy type, while your healing infusions keep that ally from granting combat advantage. Wisdom adds to every resistance you grant, and your powers siphon defenses off an enemy, teleport a battered ally to your side, or fill an armored ally with force that hurls foes away.

paths.title: Battle Engineer
paths.description: Leave the workshop behind and take your artifice straight into the front line. Your action point turns you into a harder-hitting combatant, and the weapon enchantments you grant allies become brutal and, later, noticeably more accurate. You can empower every ally standing beside you with a single strike, lace a weapon with lasting elemental force that sets critical targets burning, and fasten a zone of stinging motes to an enemy that punishes it for standing still.

paths.title: Clockwork Engineer
paths.description: Fill the battlefield with devices of your own making and treat them like members of the party. Spending an action point grants extra minor actions to command your summoned creatures, which are sturdier from the start and become faster and more accurate later on. A swarm of tiny soldiers slows enemies that enter their zone, you can mend a damaged creation by spending a healing surge, and your clockwork companion marks foes while granting nearby characters temporary hit points.

paths.title: Master Preserver
paths.description: Draw on the vital energy around you without harming it, and let that restraint make you tougher, healthier and a better steward of your allies. The land sharpens your Endurance, Nature and Perception, and an action point lets you reroll an attack or damage roll and keep the better result. At higher levels every healing surge you spend heals a nearby ally and sharpens your aim. Your spells turn an enemy's vitality into healing, shield a friend from a blow, and bathe the battlefield in a zone of weakening, restorative light.

paths.title: Spell Commander
paths.description: Command your allies like a squad leader, turning every friend into a spell delivery system. A bow or crossbow works as your implement and extends your reach, and an action point lets a nearby ally add a free attack to your own. Later, adjacent allies can swap their basic attacks for arcane at-will powers. Your powers guide spells toward a target, retune an ally's damage type as they swing, and open a living gate that teleports you and your friends across the field.
